newsitem.title: USA: Bell Industries sees ongoing weakness in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Bell Industries sees ongoing weakness in Q2.

text.p: Bell Industries Inc said Wednesday it expects the weaker sales in electronic components it experienced in the first quarter to continue into the second quarter.

Bell said it had expected the weaker first quarter operating results in the electronics group, compared to pro forma amounts, because of weaker sales and costs associated with its acquisition of Milgray Electronics in January.
Bell said it was optimistic about longer-term prospects and said it had strong sales and operating earnings in its microcomputer services and graphics imaging businesses.
"We are very pleased with the progress of the Bell-Milgray integration," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Theodore Williams.

"After completion of the integration process, we should achieve the important benefits of the Bell-Milgray merger, including stronger sales and marketing capabilities, as well as operating efficiencies for logistics and related support functions."
